source_unit: 104 previously inspected published average records in26 condition groups; not independent specimens
normalization: Reuse first-task TRAIN36 mean/sampleSD computed from copied CSV; fixed for both streams/stages/methods. No development-fitted scaling.
previous_exposure: All retained records and reporting groups inspected previously. Exploratory comparisons; no new blind-test claims.

preserved_original_A.representation: Original2-4-4CE MLP and linear results retained as historical exact-condition references, not re-labelled CIL.

TaskIncremental.decoder_candidates: The original task pair supplied for each query.
TaskIncremental.evaluation: All three pair tasks per stage; old/current/future roles explicit; pair-conditioned views may reuse averages. FinalREPORT24views/16uniqueaverages/4groups.

ClassIncremental.future_classes: Inactive until introduced; total capacity4classes known a priori.
ClassIncremental.evaluation: All and only seen classes, each unique record once per stage; no per-query pair/context label. Report acquisition by introduction-stage/class and retention on old classes. FinalREPORT16uniqueaverages/4groups.
ClassIncremental.single_class_increment: Stage2 and3 current labels singleton, but CE loss competes among all seen classes and code loss spans all8bits. No single-candidate trivial classifier.

new_code_architecture.dictionary: onehot8 first4basisvectors; WalshH8rows2..5 mappedC=(1-H)/2; +1->0, -1->1. Same fixed global dictionary perclass acrossstages.
new_code_architecture.purpose: Factorial2code×2negotiation comparisons distinguish coding effect from negotiated target mixing. Same capacity among these four methods.

negotiation.teacher: Own pre-task model predicts only current TRAIN inputs once at stage start; detached frozen predictions and targets throughout600updates. No future task rows scanned.
negotiation.no_negotiation_control: alpha=0 at every stage; samecode/dimension/loss/initialization/updates; no teacher use.
negotiation.implementation_identity: Explicit source-informed MATLAB adaptation with fixed dictionaries, not byte/exact replication of local thesis scripts or author experiments.

source_basis.actual_notebook: Task-start fixed target and Euclidean inference verified; paper/notes BCE decode wording not treated as byte-equivalent actual decoder.

CIL_CE_architecture.replay: Two earliest-by-group_order TRAIN averages per old class, unique IDs; stage2memory4/stage3memory6. Current mass1/memorymass0.5 normalized1.5.
CIL_CE_architecture.joint: Reset own initial model and Adam eachstage; train allseen TRAIN unique rows; referencewith historicalaccess, not memorymatched.

training.new_code_loss: Weighted rowmean of mean-over8bits stable logitBCE +0.5*lambda*weightmatrixnormsquared
training.optimizer_across_stages: Carryown m,v,t except jointseenreset; never transfer state between methods.

decoder.primary: Forced nearest-code class by minimum mean squared distance, or CE argmax over seen classes. No new score-gap selection threshold.
decoder.exact_tie: Record flag and use lowest eligible label deterministically; ties shown in results.
decoder.code_distance: Raw normalized squared distances pereligibleclass and top2 distancegap retained descriptively. No softmax conversion/0.15 cut on new code outputs.
decoder.CE_distance: Seen-class softmax scores and top2gap descriptive; main forceddecision.
decoder.old_A_selection: Original A0.15gap/nonselection outcomes remain as historicaloriginalcondition results; not mixed with new forced-decision populations.
decoder.reason: With paddedonehot8, exp(-mean distance) would limit maxbinarygap to tanh(1/8)<0.15, while Walsh8 permitslargergaps; commoncut would create structural unfairness.

causal_scope: Methods compared within each stream. TIL vs CIL change data presentation and information simultaneously; no attribution solely to taskidentity. Code vs ordinaryCE differ capacity/loss, so use matched code/no-negotiation controls for method effects. Onehot1activebit vsWalsh4activebits means codebook-package comparison, not isolation of orthogonality alone.

new_learning_cost.expected_cost: Small source cohort/52or32parameters; no broad grid. Wall limit is maximum, not completion promise.

launch_requirements: No output directory overwrite; log actual run once and failures
Simulink_scope: First independently reviewed SLX runs originalA final-stage savedmodels and pairdecisions; new learnedmodel deployment follows new acceptedtraining. Sampleindex not physicaltime; no mechanical dynamics inferred from staticfeatures.
future_optional_not_in_this_run: other task orders or code lengths
supersedes_candidate: A24_prospective_protocol_v1.json preserved; candidate decoder rule corrected before any run.
kernel_controls: New centraldifference BCE gradients and code/decode/mask/teacher cases only; no rerun of original acceptedA checks.
